entries.title: Romans 9:1
segments: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience bearing witness with me in the Holy Spirit,

entries.title: Romans 9:2
segments: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

entries.title: Romans 9:3
segments: For I could wish that I myself were anathema from Christ for my brethren's sake, my kinsmen according to the flesh:

entries.title: Romans 9:4
segments: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service [of God], and the promises;

entries.title: Romans 9:5
segments: whose are the fathers, and of whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.

entries.title: Romans 9:6
segments: But [it is] not as though the word of God hath come to nought. For they are not all Israel, that are of Israel:

entries.title: Romans 9:7
segments: neither, because they are Abraham's seed, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.

entries.title: Romans 9:8
segments: That is, it is not the children of the flesh that are children of God; but the children of the promise are reckoned for a seed.

entries.title: Romans 9:9
segments: For this is a word of promise, According to this season will I come, and Sarah shall have a son.

entries.title: Romans 9:10
segments: And not only so; but Rebecca also having conceived by one, [even] by our father Isaac--

entries.title: Romans 9:11
segments: for [the children] being not yet born, neither having done anything good or bad, that the purpose of God according to election might stand, not of works, but of him that calleth,

entries.title: Romans 9:12
segments: it was said unto her, The elder shall serve the younger.

entries.title: Romans 9:13
segments: Even as it is written, Jacob I loved, but Esau I hated.

entries.title: Romans 9:14
segments: What shall we say then? Is there unrighteousness with God? God forbid.

entries.title: Romans 9:15
segments: For he saith to Moses, I will have mercy on whom I have mercy, and I will have compassion on whom I have compassion.

entries.title: Romans 9:16
segments: So then it is not of him that willeth, nor of him that runneth, but of God that hath mercy.

entries.title: Romans 9:17
segments: For the scripture saith unto Pharaoh, For this very purpose did I raise thee up, that I might show in thee my power, and that my name might be published abroad in all the earth.

entries.title: Romans 9:18
segments: So then he hath mercy on whom he will, and whom he will be hardeneth.

entries.title: Romans 9:19
segments: Thou wilt say then unto me, Why doth he still find fault? For who withstandeth his will?

entries.title: Romans 9:20
segments: Nay but, O man, who art thou that repliest against God? Shall the thing formed say to him that formed it, Why didst thou make me thus?

entries.title: Romans 9:21
segments: Or hath not the potter a right over the clay, from the same lump to make one part a vessel unto honor, and another unto dishonor?

entries.title: Romans 9:22
segments: What if God, willing to show his wrath, and to make his power known, endured with much longsuffering vessels of wrath fitted unto destruction:

entries.title: Romans 9:23
segments: and that he might make known the riches of his glory upon vessels of mercy, which he afore prepared unto glory,

entries.title: Romans 9:24
segments: [even] us, whom he also called, not from the Jews only, but also from the Gentiles?

entries.title: Romans 9:25
segments: As he saith also in Hosea, I will call that my people, which was not my people; And her beloved, that was not beloved.

entries.title: Romans 9:26
segments: And it shall be, [that] in the place where it was said unto them, Ye are not my people, There shall they be called sons of the living God.

entries.title: Romans 9:27
segments: And Isaiah crieth concerning Israel, If the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, it is the remnant that shall be saved:

entries.title: Romans 9:28
segments: for the Lord will execute [his] word upon the earth, finishing it and cutting it short.

entries.title: Romans 9:29
segments: And, as Isaiah hath said before, Except the Lord of Sabaoth had left us a seed, We had become as Sodom, and had been made like unto Gomorrah.

entries.title: Romans 9:30
segments: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who followed not after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith:

entries.title: Romans 9:31
segments: but Israel, following after a law of righteousness, did not arrive at [that] law.

entries.title: Romans 9:32
segments: Wherefore? Because [they sought it] not by faith, but as it were by works. They stumbled at the stone of stumbling;

entries.title: Romans 9:33
segments: even as it is written, Behold, I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offence: And he that believeth on him shall not be put to shame.
